correctness.rationale: The boson projection and Gram permanent are derived with correct factorial normalization; independent elementary Dirichlet integration proves all t>-1 moments, including correct Gamma domain. Exact log-MGF Stirling limits are steep and strictly convex, so Gärtner–Ellis gives a good LDP for all finite or infinite mode-to-photon aspect ratios. A joint CLT for exponential variables and logarithms gives variance pi^2/6-1/alpha. LLN plus exact Haar mean gives strictly positive mean–typical exponent, checked via integral ≤1/2<gamma. Standalone numerical tests verify concrete finite cases, not general proofs.

originality.rationale: The pointwise boson bunching formula, distinguishability prefactor, Dirichlet moment machinery and classical log-spacing CLT are openly acknowledged as prior. The distinct claimed result is the explicit asymptotic all-aspect-ratio rate function and strict exponentially atypical Haar mean for this canonical multiphoton event. value.rationale: A single-output full-bunching event is a standard multiphoton interference observable. The computed strict alpha-dependent exponential mean-to-typical gap explains why Haar-average benchmarks can be wildly unrepresentative of an ordinary interferometer as photon number increases. The complete rate function quantifies both high- and low-probability tails for every asymptotic mode-to-input ratio, and normalized universality covers all pure product internal overlaps. This is a motivated growing-system distributional classification, not a renamed fixed-parameter exercise.
